summary: Lloyds Banking Group filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 7,000,000 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of 112.3817 pence per share (highest 112.8p, lowest 111.55p) as part of its existing share buyback programme. The purchases were made through Goldman Sachs International under instructions issued on 29 January 2026. The company intends to cancel these shares. This forms part of an ongoing open-market buyback program, returning capital to shareholders through share cancellation. The 6-K, a foreign private issuer report, corresponds to a US issuer's 8-K. Watch for continued execution of the buyback programme and impact on EPS.
